title: Interrupt-Aware Static Detection of Deadlocks in Rust Operating Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.30713v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rust is increasingly adopted in operating systems, but Rust's safety guarantees do not eliminate deadlocks, especially those induced by interrupts. The core challenge is to recover interrupt-sensitive lock dependencies from Rust's guard-based synchronization across function boundaries. Applying this analysis across Rust OS projects also requires specifying project-specific synchronization semantics. We present an approach combining interrupt-aware static analysis with diagnostic-guided agent auditing for detecting deadlocks in Rust operating systems. Our approach uses lightweight source-level annotations to recover project-specific lock and interrupt semantics, performs a flow-sensitive MIR-based analysis to track lock-holding and interrupt states, and reports potential deadlocks with supporting evidence. An agent then searches for relevant source code in the repository and returns a confidence assessment with reasons for each supplied r

translated_title: 面向中断感知的Rust操作系统死锁静态检测
translated_abstract: Rust在操作系统领域的应用日益广泛，但Rust的安全性保证并不能消除死锁，尤其是由中断引发的死锁。核心挑战在于跨越函数边界，从Rust基于守卫的同步机制中恢复对中断敏感的锁依赖关系。此外，将该分析应用于不同的Rust操作系统项目还需要明确项目特定的同步语义。我们提出了一种将中断感知静态分析与诊断引导的智能体审计相结合的方法，用于检测Rust操作系统中的死锁。该方法使用轻量级源代码级标注来恢复项目特定的锁与中断语义，执行基于MIR的流敏感分析以跟踪持锁与中断状态，并附带支持性证据报告潜在死锁。随后，智能体会在代码仓库中搜索相关源代码，并为每个报告返回附带理由的置信度评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合中断感知静态分析与诊断引导的智能体审计的新方法，利用轻量级源码标注和基于MIR的流敏感分析来检测Rust操作系统中由中断引发的死锁。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel approach combining interrupt-aware static analysis with diagnostic-guided agent auditing, using lightweight source-level annotations and flow-sensitive MIR-based analysis to detect interrupt-induced deadlocks in Rust operating systems.
